channel.title: XIAO AN · 3D Geospatial Engineer
channel.description: XIAO AN (WANGKANG) — 3D geospatial engineer, currently a Senior Map Engineer at Amap, working on rendering engines, GIS geometry, 3D modeling and HD map data production.

item.title: Cesium Demo Reel Index
item.description: A curated reel of early Cesium demos: map drawing, geometry editing, building extrusion, pipeline flow, masking, camera visualization, panorama blending and urban waterlogging simulation.

item.title: Batch Migrating Cesium Sandcastle Demos
item.description: Using Node.js, Selenium, jsdom and regex to batch-migrate Cesium Sandcastle demos, fixing paths, styles, data sources and entry points.

item.title: Cesium Globe + Panorama Integration
item.description: Reusing Cesium's WebGL render pipeline to blend a 3D globe with a panoramic view, without third-party libraries.

item.title: Downloading Google Earth Satellite Imagery by Extent
item.description: Computing tile coordinates and using libcurl to download satellite imagery for a geographic extent, then validating it in Cesium.

item.title: CommonJS, AMD, CMD, UMD and ES Modules
item.description: How JavaScript module systems load, differ and fit different use cases.

item.title: Cesium Label Overlap Detection
item.description: Solving label overlap in large-scale Cesium scenes with camera-distance and screen-space priority.
